Bug_Title: SING: Class using singleton design pattern directly or indirectly implements Serializable interface. (SING_SINGLETON_IMPLEMENTS_SERIALIZABLE)
Bug_Details:
This class (using singleton design pattern) directly or indirectly implements the Serializable interface, which allows the class to be serialized.
Deserialization makes multiple instantiation of a singleton class possible, and therefore should be avoided.
SEI CERT MSC07-J rule
Bug_Explanation: The SingletonSerializableBug class demonstrates the singleton design pattern and implements the Serializable interface, which allows the class to be serialized. This can break the singleton property by allowing multiple instances via deserialization.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case attempts to validate the singleton property by comparing two instances. It fails to do so because the class implements Serializable, which can create multiple instances through deserialization, thus breaking the singleton property.
